Description: ML Container Creator CI Integration Harness - automated lifecycle testing infrastructure

MaxConcurrency.Description: Maximum number of parallel CodeBuild executions

CodeBuildComputeType.Description: CodeBuild compute type for CI executor

CreateBenchmarkInfra.Description: Whether to create benchmark infrastructure (S3 results bucket, Glue DB/table, IAM permissions). Opt-in.

BenchmarkIaTransitionDays.Description: Days before benchmark results transition to Infrequent Access storage

BenchmarkExpirationDays.Description: Days before benchmark results expire and are deleted

CreatePathProver.Description: Whether to create Path Prover infrastructure (state machine, Lambdas, EventBridge rule). Opt-in.

EnablePathProverSchedule.Description: Whether to enable the Path Prover scheduled EventBridge rule. Default: DISABLED.

BootstrapVersion.Description: Version of the CDK Bootstrap resources in this environment, automatically retrieved from SSM Parameter Store. [cdk:skip]
